summary: A two bedroom part-furnished first floor flat at the head of a pleasant cul-de-sac.
description:
This deligthful property has its own entrance, via a shared external stairway and balcony, with allocated parking space for 1 car. The accommodation offers hallway, open plan lounge with kitchen area, two bedrooms and bathroom with electric shower over the bath.

EPC: C COUNCIL TAX: BAND B

TENANCY AGREEMENT Available under the terms of an Assured Periodic Tenancy.

RENT AND DEPOSIT Rent: £875 and Security Deposit: £1,009.62 are both payable prior to the start of the tenancy. The deposit will be paid into a Tenancy Deposit Scheme and refunded at the termination of the tenancy, subject to the property being left in a clean and tenantable condition. The successful applicant(s) will pay a refundable holding deposit of £201.93 (equivalent to 1 week’s rent), prior to the reference/credit checks, which can then be deducted from the first month’s rent, or refunded if applicants have not provided any false or misleading information.

OUTGOINGS: The Tenant will be responsible for all outgoings (telephone, broadband, utilities, council tax etc.) and to maintain the property in a reasonable and tenantable condition

SPECIAL CONDITIONS: 1 small dog may be considered by the landlord. Non-smokers only.

VIEWING: Strictly by appointment through our Kendal Office: .

Directions Leave Kendal on A65, passing Kendal leisure centre and then bear left at the traffic lights onto Oxenholme Road towards Oxenholme railway station. Follow the road through the traffic lights and over the mini roundabout, then take the first left onto Hayclose Road and the first right onto Howe Bank Close. Bear left and you will see the stairs leading up to no. 12 at the far end of the cul de sac.

Location Howe Bank Close is a private residential area to the southern suburbs of Kendal. The property provides easy access to several surrounding amenities including Kendal leisure centre, Asda superstore and Westmorland General Hospital. Oxenholme train station is a short walk away for mainline commuter links to Manchester, London Euston, Edinburgh and Glasgow.

Outside Allocated parking space is on the right hand side of the parking space at the foot of the entrance steps. Access to drying area and bin storage area from Hayclose Road.
